main_text.p: nut ante in Pihel. Hithpahel התְּקַדֵּשׁ Sanctificari, Sanctificare seipsum, Parare, Præparare se ad sanctitatem.
קָדוֹשׁ m. Sanctus, Sanctum: plur. קְדוֹשִׁים.
קָדִישׁ m. Chald. Idem: plur. קְדִישִׁין.
קֹדֶשׁ m. Sanctitas, Res sancta, Sanctum, Sacrum: plur. קֳדָשִׁים.
קָדֵשׁ m. Meritorius, Cinædus: plur. קְדֵשִׁים. Feminin. קְדֵשָׁה Prostibulum, Meretrix, & gravius significat, quàm זוֹנָה Scortum: plur. קְדֵשׁוֹת.
מִקְדָּשׁ m. Sanctuarium: Asylum: plurale, מִקְדָּשִׁים.
קָהַר Obstupescere, Obtusum fieri. Pihel קִהָּה Hebetavit.
קהל Niphal נִקְהַל Congregari, Congregare se. Hiphil הִקְהִיל Congregare.
קֹהֶלֶת f. Congregans, Congregatrix, scil. anima Salomonis regis, Eccles. 7.28, ubi tantum femininum est. Aliàs semper masculinum, pro Salomone congregante, & sic est ἐκκλησιαστὴς, Ecclesiastes.
מְקֻהָלִים m. p. Congregationes: fem. מְקֻהָלוֹת.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel pointing and some Hebrew words in the headword column are uncertain at the scan edges; the ink blot near the middle of the page obscures part of the line beginning "Pihel" and the line "Obstupescere" may be partly damaged. Greek word ἐκκλησιαστής is as printed in Greek letters, reproduced here by best reading.
